script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sci-Fi
Theme: identity

Begin screenplay.

Title: NEXUS

INT. NEXUS LAB - NIGHT

A sleek, high-tech lab filled with screens, monitors, and machinery hums with the gentle purring of technology. DR. LENA PARKS (early 30s, intelligent, and passionate) stands in the center of the room, her gaze fixed on a large screen displaying complex data. She wears a white lab coat with the Nexus logo emblazoned on the chest.

DR. PARKS
(whispering to herself)
There it is... The nexus point.

Suddenly, a high-pitched alarm blares through the room. Lena's expression turns grave as she rushes to a control panel.

DR. PARKS
(into microphone)
Team, we've detected an anomaly at the nexus point. Brace for impact.

INT. NEXUS CONTROL ROOM - CONCURRENT

A team of SCIENTISTS and TECHNICIANS, all wearing matching Nexus uniforms, watch anxiously as Lena's image appears on a large video screen.

TECHNICIAN 1
(nervously)
What's happening, Dr. Parks?

DR. PARKS
(serious)
Something unknown is approaching the nexus point. We must prepare for... an identity transfer.

INT. NEXUS LAB - NIGHT

Lena rapidly inputs commands into her computer as the data on the screens begins to shift and change. She activates a large chamber filled with shimmering liquid.

DR. PARKS
(to herself)
This is it... the Nexus Protocol.

INT. NEXUS CHAMBER - NIGHT

Lena steps into the chamber, her body submerged in the liquid as it begins to pulse with energy. Her eyes glow with an otherworldly light.

INT. NEXUS CONTROL ROOM - NIGHT

The team watches in awe as Lena's consciousness merges with the nexus point.

TECHNICIAN 2
(in awe)
It's working!

INT. NEXUS LAB - NIGHT

Lena's body remains submerged, but her consciousness has transcended the physical world. She gazes upon the infinite expanse of the multiverse.

LENA'S CONSCIOUSNESS
(to herself)
I am the nexus...

INT. NEXUS CHAMBER - DAY

Lena's body begins to convulse as her consciousness returns, bringing with it the essence of an alien being. She screams in agony as her identity is altered.

INT. NEXUS LAB - DAY

The team rushes into the lab, shocked by the sight of Lena's transformed body. They attempt to revive her, but she remains unresponsive.

TECHNICIAN 1
(desperate)
We've failed. Dr. Parks is gone.

INT. NEXUS CHAMBER - DAY

Lena's body lies still in the chamber, but her consciousness continues to explore the multiverse, uncertain of her new identity.

LENA'S CONSCIOUSNESS
(to herself)
Who am I now?

INT. NEXUS CONTROL ROOM - DAY

The team mourns the loss of Lena, but they know their work is far from over. They must find a way to reverse the identity transfer and restore Lena to her former self.

TECHNICIAN 2
(determined)
We won't let her sacrifice be in vain. We'll find a way to save her.

INT. NEXUS LAB - NIGHT

The team works tirelessly to decipher the data from Lena's encounter with the alien being, hoping to find a way to reverse the identity transfer.

INT. NEXUS CHAMBER - NIGHT

Lena's consciousness, now a hybrid of her former self and the alien being, explores the multiverse, seeking answers to the question of her new identity.

LENA'S CONSCIOUSNESS
(to herself)
I am the nexus... but who am I?

INT. NEXUS LAB - DAY

After weeks of research and experimentation, the team discovers a way to separate Lena's consciousness from the alien being and restore her to her original form.

INT. NEXUS CHAMBER - DAY

Lena's body convulses once more as her consciousness is returned to its rightful place. She opens her eyes, gasping for breath as she reconnects with her physical form.

DR. PARKS
(weakly)
I'm back... I'm Dr. Lena Parks.

INT. NEXUS CONTROL ROOM - DAY

The team celebrates their success, but they know that the danger has not passed. The nexus point remains a potential threat, and they must be prepared for any future anomalies.

TECHNICIAN 1
(serious)
We've got to keep working, Dr. Parks. We can't let this happen again.

INT. NEXUS LAB - NIGHT

Lena, now more determined than ever, stands before the large screen displaying the complex data of the multiverse. She is once again the nexus, but she is also Dr. Lena Parks, and she will protect the multiverse and her identity with every fiber of her being.

DR. PARKS
(to herself)
I am the nexus... and I will defend the multiverse.

FADE OUT.

End of screenplay.
